dedupe_keys.name: colombia decarbonisation energy system model input tables

description: The Mendeley Data release provides three Excel workbooks named MODEL DATA, SETS and SUPPLEMENTARY DATA for Colombia decarbonisation modelling. The authors compiled information from national and international public sources and research papers to represent historical and projected end-use demand, capital and operating costs, efficiency, plant lifetime, capacity factors, residual capacity, emissions and energy availability. The article says the tables were used with OSeMOSYS, but the repository states they are independent of that tool. Version 1 is public under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is national energy-system planning through 2050, not a feeder-level network or an observed dispatch series. Values pooled from reports and forecasts have source and scenario uncertainty; this review did not reconcile each workbook parameter to its cited origin. A reviewer-assessed use is building or comparing national transition scenarios. model-osemosys is a related model, without a verified import or reproduced pathway. No spreadsheet was downloaded or run.
